person.name: Dariusz Tomczak
person.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
person.summary: Senior Full Stack Developer with expertise in C#, Java, and cloud technologies, specializing in application modernization and DevOps practices. Experienced in containerizing applications with Docker, migrating to cloud platforms (Nomad, AWS), and building robust CI/CD pipelines. Strong background in financial services with a passion for leveraging AI to streamline development workflows.

highlights: Dockerizing Java applications and migrating from VMs to Nomad cloud for scalability.
Improving CI/CD pipelines with automation and deployment reliability.
Collaborating with stakeholders to refine requirements and manage tasks in Jira.
Developing automated tests using Gherkin for robust test coverage.
Creating an AI code review workflow using MCP servers connected to GitLab and Atlassian APIs.
Creating an Agentic AI workflow to automate running BDD tests.
Migrating CI/CD pipelines from VM-based infrastructure to Amazon Web Services (AWS) for improved scalability and deployment reliability.
Developing an MCP server that connects a chat agent to the UI using WinAppDriver and FlaUI for automated desktop application interaction.
Optimized and enhanced the internal trading application.
Migrated from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 6 for improved performance.
Developed unit tests to ensure code reliability and maintainability.
Conducted code reviews to enforce best practices and architectural guidelines.
Redesigned data acquisition for scalability, efficiency, and real-time processing.
Transitioned from a monolithic architecture to microservices and REST APIs.
Provided technical support and troubleshooting for end-users.
Developed business applications in Access and Excel VBA for Ireland Fund Accounting.
Designed and supported SQL database applications.
Built standalone applications with WinForms and WPF (XAML) in .NET.
Created VSTO tools for Microsoft Office in Visual Studio.
Analyzed business requirements to develop effective solutions.
Maintained and debugged existing Python applications.
Conducted GMAS Remediation to assess business applications, macros, and Python scripts for quality, performance, and security.
Developed business applications in Access and Excel VBA.
Created VSTO tools for Microsoft Office in Visual Studio.
Provided VBA training for the IRE department.
Designed and supported SQL database applications using SQLite.
Developed macros in Excel VBA as a member of the Macro Support Group.
